plan.title: Block restart when cancelled subprocess cleanup cannot be confirmed

criteria.description: Surface cancellation with a surviving child preserves interruption and blocks restart pending recovery.
Check cancellation and timeout preserve their results while unresolved children invalidate evidence.
Process-group inspection fails closed on errors and never sends another destructive signal after wait.
A fresh process refuses executions with unresolved prior ownership.

limitations: Unix process groups only; deliberate process-group escape is outside this boundary.
No repeated post-wait destructive signals; unresolved descendants require manual recovery.
Go 1.23 and Linux/Windows runtime validation require available environments; cross-vet is static evidence only.
No push integration tests, deployment, tool installation or new dependencies.
